transportRole: internal Company Runtime transport; not the product's primary command port

desktopHost.bootstrap: BODY and Guardian are separate local components; Guardian connects to BODY as an external authority
desktopHost.guardianGate: Guardian is external. Brain physical execution is fail-closed at BODY's CDP boundary unless Guardian has issued a current grant.

identity.applicationModel: one Company Runtime application per Device by default
identity.legacyV5BrowserFallback: browser-<extensionInstanceId> when an older v5 adapter has no browserInstanceId

authentication.debugClient: 256-bit local token from daemon/profiles/.auth/client.token or BODY_DEBUG_TOKEN
authentication.extension: TOFU pairing bound to extensionInstanceId + runtimeExtensionId + browserInstanceId when supplied

controllerPolicy.human: highest authority; local operator control is outside Brain planning and Guardian policy decisions
controllerPolicy.guardian: second authority; may allow or revoke Brain CDP execution for each Browser Instance
controllerPolicy.brain: planner/controller; physical execution requires an explicitly RUNNING taskId plus a current Guardian grant
controllerPolicy.body: no policy authority; observes and executes

brain.physicalActionRequirement: BODY_STEP requires contractVersion=1.0, a durable stepId, an explicitly RUNNING taskId, exactly one Body step, and a current external Guardian grant immediately before physical CDP dispatch

bodyContract.stepIdentity: taskId + stepId; requestId is transport-only and does not change Body step identity
bodyContract.deliverySemantics: durable at-most-once physical execution; duplicate completed steps replay the stored result; unresolved durable reservations return body_step_outcome_unknown and are never physically re-executed
bodyContract.eyes: BODY_OBSERVE returns raw structured browser/page/UI evidence and freshness only; it contains no Guardian eligibility, device/IP policy, task judgment, retry advice, or next-action recommendation
invariants: one taskId+stepId identity requests one Body step and permits at most one physical attempt
BODY returns observable facts and technical execution state, never task or Guardian judgment
Brain alone decides semantic success/failure and next step
Guardian alone decides whether Brain CDP may pass
Human local authority is above Guardian
BODY learning may shape physical HOW, never WHAT goal to pursue
Human and Agent provenance remain separate
Brain never accesses CDP/native-input/MotorLearning internals directly

taskWorkspace.invariant: one tab belongs to at most one active TaskWorkspace; BODY tracks ownership mechanically and does not classify task policy

debugClient.purpose: Human/local operator smoke testing and diagnostics; higher authority than Brain/Guardian policy

browserUi.executionBackend: persistent Windows SendInput worker plus bounded browser API fast path

hello.token: paired token or null on first pairing

responsibilities: public IP, proxy and VPN observation
allow or revoke Brain CDP execution
guardian.cdpGate: short-lived per-Browser grant; revoked on Guardian disconnect; BODY does not evaluate policy
